title: Strategy City Builder Resource Overlay
summary: Strategy interface mockup for resource flows, build priorities, worker pressure, and readable map overlays.
prompt: Create an in-game strategy overlay for {argument name="game_title" default="Frostworks Dominion"}, a city builder with survival pressure. Show a readable settlement map with resource nodes, worker assignments, heat coverage, production bottlenecks, building queue, threat forecast, and morale status. Use restrained but game-native UI: clear iconography, layered map overlays, controller and mouse readability, and no business analytics motifs.
